split.name: T6 real-video clip holdout
split.selection: Fixed by clip before any detector changes: one dissolve per partition, modern and archival footage in each. No event from a held-out clip is used for tuning. Calibration includes the no-cut monologue and rapid NASA montage.
split.limitations: The V1 report and aggregate failures were supplied before this split. This is a tuning holdout, not a blind or source-work-disjoint benchmark. Labels are provisional single-annotator visual judgments, exhaustive only inside their declared windows.
split.protocol: Tune only calibration clips and synthetic regression cases. Freeze detector source hashes before running v6 on held_out. Report that first held-out result without changing decision rules in response. Keep labels and scoring tolerances unchanged.

media_verification: All ten clip hashes and four source hashes match manifest; source worktree read only; no downloads.

scoring.unknown: Per class: missed truth intersected by an explicit unknown; total: unknown events intersecting reviewed windows. Unmatched labels remain FN.
scoring.scope: Exhaustive labels only for hard cuts/dissolves in 45.75 reviewed seconds. Other classes have no labeled positives; undefined recall, not zero accuracy.

limitations: The prior V1 failure report was known before splitting; holdout is for tuning, not blind evaluation.
Clips share source works across partitions; small denominators and one annotator do not establish broad real-video accuracy.
The held-out title dissolve still fails; no decision rule was changed after the first held-out run.
Published validation metadata was updated after evaluation; decision AST hash excludes only VALIDATION_STATUS and EXPERIMENTAL_RECALL_WARNING.
CFR derivatives, grayscale spatial features, transitions under 1.5 s; VFR timing, chroma-only cuts and long/off-center effects remain unvalidated.

real_clip.command: ZING_REAL_TRANSITIONS=1 ZING_REAL_EVAL_ROOT=<pinned root> uv run --frozen pytest -q tests/test_transition_v6.py -m real_media

validation_commands.note: Six pre-existing optional runtime skips plus the separately exercised local real-media test. Runtime measurements include concurrent checks; not a speed benchmark.
